conversationalSummary.text: TODAY looks like one of those no-reliable-window days, mainly because the wind setup is pretty off for Cantinho da Baia and the waves are likely too weak even around mid tide. I’d check the Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam before leaving, and only bother heading out if they look noticeably cleaner than expected—otherwise save the drive.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 129 kJ, 7 s period, very consistent 83/100, and wind is the main risk.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is still too weak in the sheltered bay; SwellMap rating 1/10 Poor — caution.
best.shortExplanation: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for mid-morning — 11:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is a bit awkward for the bay, so stay cautious.
